column1: # Test-image manifest for the multi-image checkers (check_nix.sh: linux+mac, check_win_images.sh: windows)
# and the reference generator (py_refs_images.sh). The main Windows image (memory-dirty.raw, refs in
# bench/ref/py) is NOT listed here: check_all.sh covers it.
# Columns (TAB separated):  name  os  image_path  symbol_args  ref_dir
#   os          windows | linux | mac  -> plugin list bench/{win,linux,mac}_noarg.txt
#   symbol_args extra global args for python vol / fvol ("-" = none); word-split, no quoting (";" separates
#               several -s dirs, as in vol3). symbols-extra holds ISFs that are NOT on the MS symbol server:
#               python deletes a same-named file in the first -s dir when its identifier cache misses the entry
#               and the download fails, so such files must not live in the first dir.
#   plugin_list optional 6th column: plugin list file (relative to bench/) used by py_refs_images.sh; default
#               {win,linux,mac}_noarg.txt. Format-variant images (same guest/OS as a fully referenced image,
#               different container format) use the reduced *_fmt_noarg.txt lists. The checkers compare every
#               plugin of the default list that has a reference file, so they need no list column.
# Provenance + details of each image: testdata/README.md
